summary: AI Memory & Knowledge Brain sprint tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases pass (memory CRUD, list filters/sort, stats, merge, pin, toggle learning, learn/event auto-distill at threshold=4, learn/analyze, insights, business-profile generate + get, search, ask/brain, org isolation across 2 demo tenants, smart-reuse regression: proposals generator + assistant chat still 200). LLM endpoints returned real answers (no 502 budget errors). Frontend: /knowledge-brain page renders knowledge-brain-page, 4 brain-stat, 6 memory-card (seeded), 5 brain-insight, ask-brain box, sort, search, category chips, and controls (pin, edit-modal, save, delete with toast, toggle-learning, new-memory, merge-mode with memory-select + merge-confirm, analyze-learning). Ask returned pricing answer from memories. Delete showed 'Deleted' toast and counter dropped 6->5. Nav 'Knowledge Brain' present in sidebar. No console errors observed.
critical_code_review_comments: memory.py: _analyze_events dedupes by exact-title (case-insensitive) which is fine, but note that distilled titles from LLM can drift ('Prefers concise introductions' vs 'Prefers concise intro') creating near-duplicates; consider a lightweight similarity check in the future.
list_memories uses double sort (stable) to keep pinned first — works, but could be simplified to a single tuple key.
Business profile POST returns doc that may retain no _id (pop is guarded) — OK; sections may be None if extract_json fails silently; consider validating schema.
learn/event endpoint always attempts auto-analyze when pending>=4 but swallows exceptions — good; would benefit from returning last-error diagnostic in dev mode.
test_credentials: Demo auth via POST /api/auth/demo (fresh tenant each call); UI: data-testid='explore-demo-btn' on /login.
seed_data_creation: Demo seeds 6 starter memories per fresh tenant (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_knowledge_brain.py covers all /api/memory endpoints incl. org isolation and generator/assistant regression. LLM budget was healthy at test time — if 502 recurs, tests skip gracefully. Frontend UI drive covered create/search/pin/edit/toggle-learning/ask/analyze/merge/delete/sort.
